notes: Loading everything is fast again. Preparing signals used to ask for one share at a time - thousands of separate requests - and that path went out to the old data provider whose key was removed on 13 August when the daily feed moved. Every one of those requests was failing or timing out, which is why loading crawled. The app now pulls history from your own server 200 shares per request before the loop starts, so the work is already done by the time it runs. Measured on a 500-share test: 2,501 requests and just over two minutes became 3 requests and fifteen seconds. Anything the server genuinely does not hold still falls back to the old path, so no share is left without history.
